app/api/admin/dashboard/stats/route.ts.name: Dashboard sales summary
app/api/admin/dashboard/stats/route.ts.description: Returns headline sales and order statistics for the admin dashboard.

app/api/admin/inquiries/route.ts.name: Bespoke enquiry list
app/api/admin/inquiries/route.ts.description: Lists bespoke-jewellery enquiries submitted by customers, with optional status filtering.

app/api/admin/inventory/route.ts.name: Stock management
app/api/admin/inventory/route.ts.description: Lists current stock levels and lets staff update the quantity or low-stock threshold for any variant.

app/api/admin/orders/route.ts.name: All orders list
app/api/admin/orders/route.ts.description: Lists every customer order with optional filtering by status, for staff review.

GET /api/admin/dashboard/stats.name: View dashboard stats
GET /api/admin/dashboard/stats.description: Returns key sales figures and order counts for the admin dashboard.

GET /api/admin/inquiries.name: List bespoke enquiries
GET /api/admin/inquiries.description: Returns bespoke-jewellery enquiries, optionally filtered by status, for staff to review.

GET /api/admin/inventory.name: View stock levels
GET /api/admin/inventory.description: Returns stock quantities for all products or a single product's variants.

POST /api/admin/inventory.name: Update stock level
POST /api/admin/inventory.description: Sets the stock quantity or low-stock alert threshold for a specific product variant.

GET /api/admin/orders.name: List all orders
GET /api/admin/orders.description: Returns every order across all customers, optionally filtered by status.
